package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/gwapp/internal/storage/queries/gateways"
)

// Store is the authored gateway adapter.
type Store struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewStore(db scope.DB) *Store { return &Store{db: db} }

// Create inserts a pending gateway and mints its enrollment token in the
// same transaction.
func (s *Store) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.NewGateway,
) (models.CreatedGateway, error) {
	var out models.CreatedGateway

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		id, err := queriesOf(tx).CreateGateway(
			ctx,
			queries.CreateGatewayParams{OrgID: tx.Tenant(), Name: in.Name},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		token, _, err := tx.IssueEnrollment(ctx, "gateways.Gateway", id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.CreatedGateway{ID: id, Token: token}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

// Beat updates the verified machine's own row: the tenant and the machine id
// come from the transaction, never from the request.
func (s *Store) Beat(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.Beat,
) (models.Ack, error) {
	var out models.Ack

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		seq, err := queriesOf(tx).Beat(ctx, queries.BeatParams{
			OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
			ID:    tx.SubjectID(),
			Seq:   in.Seq,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.Ack{Seq: seq}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

func (s *Store) Status(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.StatusRequest,
) (models.GatewayStatus, error) {
	var out models.GatewayStatus

	err := s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		row, err := queriesOf(tx).GatewayStatus(
			ctx,
			queries.GatewayStatusParams{
				OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
				ID:    tx.SubjectID(),
			},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.GatewayStatus{
			ID:      row.ID,
			Name:    row.Name,
			State:   row.State,
			LastSeq: row.LastSeq,
			Echo:    in.Echo,
		}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}
